title: General intelligence event types
description: Context-preserving types for real-world developments represented as intelligence events.

terms.label: Conflict
terms.definition: Organized hostile confrontation involving armed, political or communal actors.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include sustained or material hostile confrontation; exclude isolated crime and ordinary political disagreement.

terms.label: Security incident
terms.definition: A discrete event that threatens public, organizational or infrastructure security.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include attacks, major security breaches and violent incidents; exclude sustained conflict classified as CONFLICT.

terms.label: Ceasefire
terms.definition: A declared or implemented pause or cessation in organized hostilities.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include formal and materially observed ceasefires; exclude informal reductions in violence without a cessation arrangement. CEASEFIRE is independent from CONFLICT because it describes a distinct development rather than a subtype of conflict.

terms.label: Election
terms.definition: A formal public process for selecting representatives or deciding a ballot question.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include election scheduling, voting and certified results; exclude appointments made without a public electoral process.

terms.label: Government change
terms.definition: A material change in national or subnational executive leadership or governing coalition.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include inauguration, resignation, removal and coalition replacement; exclude routine staff appointments.

terms.label: Policy change
terms.definition: Adoption, withdrawal or material revision of a public policy position or program.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include nonbinding and administrative policy changes; use REGULATORY_CHANGE where binding regulatory rules are central.

terms.label: Regulatory change
terms.definition: Creation, amendment or repeal of a binding regulatory requirement.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include enforceable rules and standards; exclude general policy intentions without a binding instrument.

terms.label: Diplomatic event
terms.definition: A formal international engagement, agreement, dispute or change in diplomatic relations.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include state and intergovernmental diplomatic action; exclude ordinary commercial meetings.

terms.label: Protest or civil unrest
terms.definition: Collective public demonstration, disorder or civil disturbance outside organized armed conflict.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include protests, riots and disruptive civil mobilization; exclude routine public events and sustained armed conflict.

terms.label: Humanitarian crisis
terms.definition: A severe situation creating widespread urgent needs for protection or life-sustaining assistance.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include acute multi-person humanitarian need; exclude isolated hardship and routine development challenges.

terms.label: Displacement
terms.definition: Material forced or crisis-driven movement of people from their usual residence.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include refugee and internally displaced movements; exclude routine voluntary migration.

terms.label: Disease outbreak
terms.definition: An observed increase or spread of disease above expected conditions.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Use for human disease in general context; animal or plant outbreaks also require their agricultural-domain classification.

terms.label: Health emergency
terms.definition: A health threat requiring exceptional public-health coordination or response.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include officially declared or operationally exceptional health situations; exclude routine health-service updates.

terms.label: Economic shock
terms.definition: A sudden development with material economy-wide effects on output, employment, finance or confidence.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include broad abrupt economic disruptions; exclude ordinary market variation and sector-only changes.

terms.label: Price shock
terms.definition: A sudden and material price movement with significant economic or sectoral consequences.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include abrupt consequential price changes; exclude routine price reporting and minor volatility.

terms.label: Trade restriction
terms.definition: A new or materially changed barrier limiting movement or exchange of goods or services.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include tariffs, bans, quotas, sanctions and border restrictions; exclude logistical delays without a trade rule.

terms.label: Trade agreement
terms.definition: A formal arrangement changing terms of trade between participating jurisdictions or organizations.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include signed or implemented trade accords; exclude preliminary talks without an agreed instrument.

terms.label: Energy supply disruption
terms.definition: A material interruption or reduction in fuel or electricity availability.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include outages, embargo effects and production shortfalls; exclude price-only changes without supply interruption.

terms.label: Infrastructure disruption
terms.definition: Loss or degradation of essential physical infrastructure capacity.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include roads, ports, utilities, storage and communication infrastructure; exclude service delays without infrastructure impairment.

terms.label: Logistics disruption
terms.definition: A material interruption in transport, storage, handling or distribution operations.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include blocked routes, port congestion and distribution breakdowns; exclude legal trade restrictions without an operational disruption.

terms.label: Weather event
terms.definition: A discrete meteorological event or materially significant weather condition.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include storms, heatwaves, cold spells and exceptional rainfall; exclude long-term climate trends without a discrete event.

terms.label: Natural disaster
terms.definition: A natural hazard producing substantial human, environmental, infrastructure or economic loss.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include hazards with material realized consequences; use WEATHER_EVENT alone where significant disaster impacts are not established.

terms.label: Public event
terms.definition: An organized gathering or occasion intended for public participation or attention.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include cultural, civic and major public gatherings; exclude protests, elections and emergency incidents.

terms.label: Sport event
terms.definition: An organized athletic competition, tournament or major sporting occasion.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include competitive sporting events; exclude routine fitness activity and non-sport public gatherings.

terms.label: Research release
terms.definition: Publication of a substantive research result, assessment, dataset or scientific report.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include new evidence or analysis; exclude routine news summaries that add no substantive research output.

terms.label: Technology launch
terms.definition: Public introduction of a new or materially revised technology offering or platform.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include operational product or platform launches; exclude research concepts without a released offering.

terms.label: Funding or investment
terms.definition: A committed allocation of capital, grants or financing to an organization, program or asset.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include announced committed funding; exclude aspirations or discussions without a defined allocation.

terms.label: Program announcement
terms.definition: Formal launch or material expansion of an organized public, humanitarian, research or development program.
terms.inclusionBoundary: Include defined programs with objectives or resources; exclude general statements of intent.
